page.overview:
Who is Firefly?

Firefly is an explosives/demolitions expert, and is also an accomplished pilot.

As many other versions of Firefly, this version favors explosive devices: grenades, RPGs, rockets, etc. However unlike other portrayed versons, this one shows heightened skills in hand-to-hand combat. It again shown that he possesses a skill for infiltration; being able to easily invade the prison from the outside single-handedly. He also displays improved marksmen skills, and perfect timing. This version is also given a signature weapon; dubbed "The FireFlies". A swarm on micro but powerful explosives, that appears similar to, and act like FireFlies. Also unlike his other versions (excluding the G.I. Renegades version) he displays a great deal of arrogance that does not allow to be as cautious as his original counterparts.

Part of Cobra Firefly helped Storm Shadow and Cobra commander break out of prison. Using his fireflies and other explosives he busted in and blew up any security. As they left Storm Shadow got injured by an explosion caused by a guard. Firefly dragged him to the chopper and the three took off.

He later was guarding Zartan and used his fireflies to attack Roadblock who tried to kill Zartan. They engaged in hand-to-hand combat and Firefly savagely beat up Roadblock as he mocked him about the dead Joes. He prepared to execute him however he was forced to flee as the other Joes showed up.
